add-column: invoices.sent_at is nullable and default-free, a catalog-only addition without a table rewrite, under a 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-policy: Every policy is installed on the new, empty payments table under a 1s lock_timeout; the expressions read only settings, table ownership, or the invoice row a payment names, and no existing rows.
create-table-references: The foreign keys are installed with a new empty table, so no existing rows are scanned; the 1s lock_timeout bounds the brief locks on organization and invoices.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE RLS apply only to the new empty payments table before application traffic can reach it, under a 1s lock_timeout.
